s.note: Crisp coconut-crumbed prawns with lime mayo. Patsy bangs two coconut halves together.
s.how: Dust the prawns in seasoned flour, dip in beaten egg, then press into the coconut mixed with panko. Fry in hot oil in batches until golden, about 2 minutes. Stir lime zest and juice into the mayo. Serve the prawns hot with the lime mayo.
shop: 500g raw king prawns, peeled with tails on@Seafood

s.note: Honey and soy chicken wings with sesame. The bridgekeeper's unladen swallow.
s.how: Toss the wings with the honey, soy, garlic and ginger. Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C, turning once, until sticky and dark. Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onions to serve.

m.note: Slow-braised rabbit under a golden pastry lid. The rabbit that sees off three knights.
m.how: Toss the rabbit in seasoned flour and brown in the oil, then set aside. Fry the bacon, carrot and onion until soft. Return the rabbit with the apple juice, stock, mustard and thyme and simmer covered until tender. Pull the meat from the bones and tip the filling into a pie dish. Top with pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

m.note: Slow-roast lamb shoulder with garlic and rosemary. And the people did feast upon the lambs.
m.how: Stab the lamb all over and push in the garlic and rosemary, then rub with oil and salt. Sit the lamb on the potatoes and onions, pour in the stock, cover and roast at 160C. Uncover and roast at 200C until the skin is crisp and the potatoes are golden. Rest, then pull the meat from the bone and serve with mint jelly.

w.note: Apples and dark berries under an oat crumble. Your father smelt of elderberries.
w.how: Toss the apples and berries with the cordial and brown sugar in a baking dish. Rub the butter into the flour, oats and caster sugar until it clumps. Scatter over the fruit and bake at 180C until golden and bubbling. Serve warm with the custard.
shop: 5 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced@Produce

d.note: Mint and cucumber soda over plenty of ice. The Knights Who Say Ni want a shrubbery.
d.how: Heat the sugar and water until dissolved, add half the mint and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, cucumber, the rest of the mint and a squeeze of lime. Add the strained syrup and top with soda.
